corrected_draft.title: HHS Reconstitutes CDC Vaccine Advisory Committee ACIP
corrected_draft.description_short: On June 9, 2025, the Department of Health and Human Services announced that it had reconstituted the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices. HHS described the change as…
corrected_draft.description_medium: On June 9, 2025, the Department of Health and Human Services announced that it had reconstituted the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices. HHS described the change as replacing the committee’s membership. This supports a discrete committee reconstitution, but it does not support the record’s February 10 date or wording that Kennedy fired the committee on that date; those details should be corrected or omitted.
corrected_draft.description_long: The Department of Health and Human Services announced on June 9, 2025 that it had reconstituted the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices, the committee that advises the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention on vaccine use. The department’s announcement described the action as a total reconstitution and connected it to the administration’s stated science policy. This is a supportable, dated institutional action. The held record places the event on February 10 and says Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. fired the entire panel; the supplied official announcement located in focused research dates the reconstitution to June 9 instead. The record should use the later date and HHS’s precise description, and should not imply that all members were dismissed in February absent contemporaneous documentation.
